text: Morgan Stanley raised its price target on Charles Schwab Corp (SCHW) to $148 from $139, reflecting a constructive view on the brokerage and wealth-management giant. The move came amid a broader wave of Tuesday research updates, with Morgan Stanley also lifting targets on exchange peers CME Group, CBOE Global Markets, Intercontinental Exchange, Nasdaq, and Raymond James Financial, while trimming targets for LPL Financial, MarketAxess, and Virtu Financial. This suggests improving analyst sentiment across financial-services and exchange stocks broadly, with Schwab specifically seen as having incremental upside potential based on Morgan Stanley’s revised outlook.
